with job_run_timeline_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t2.job_id,
    t2.run_id,
    t1.identity_metadata.run_as as run_as,
    t2.result_state,
    t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default as list_cost
  FROM system.billing.usage t1
    INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2
      ON
        t1.workspace_id=t2.workspace_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id
        AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time)
        AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
    INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices on
      t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud and
      t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name and
      t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time and
      (t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time or list_prices.price_end_time is null)
  WHERE
    t1.sku_name LIKE '%JOBS%' AND 
    t1.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
),
cumulative_run_status_cost as (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, 
    job_id,
    run_id,
    run_as,
    result_state,
    usage_end_time,
    SUM(list_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost
  FROM job_run_timeline_with_cost
  ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time
),
cost_per_status as (
  SELECT
      workspace_id, 
      job_id,
      run_id,
      run_as,
      result_state,
      usage_end_time,
      cumulative_cost - COALESCE(LAG(cumulative_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time), 0) AS result_state_cost
  FROM cumulative_run_status_cost
  WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time),
cost_per_unsuccesful_status_agg as (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, 
    job_id,
    run_id,
    first(run_as, TRUE) as run_as,
    SUM(result_state_cost) as list_cost
  FROM cost_per_status
  WHERE
    result_state != "SUCCEEDED"
  GROUP BY ALL
),
repaired_runs as (
  SELECT 
    workspace_id, job_id, run_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
  WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING cnt > 1
),
successful_repairs as (
  SELECT t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, t1.run_id, MAX(t1.period_end_time) as period_end_time
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t1
  JOIN repaired_runs t2
  ON t1.workspace_id=t2.workspace_id AND t1.job_id=t2.job_id AND t1.run_id=t2.run_id
  WHERE t1.result_state="SUCCEEDED"
  GROUP BY ALL
),
combined_repairs as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t2.period_end_time, 
    t1.cnt as repairs
  FROM repaired_runs t1
    LEFT JOIN successful_repairs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id)
),
most_recent_jobs as (
  SELECT 
    *, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) as rn
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs QUALIFY rn=1
)
SELECT
  last(t3.name) as name,
  t1.workspace_id,
  t1.job_id,
  t1.run_id,
  first(t4.run_as, TRUE) as run_as,
  first(t1.repairs) - 1 as repairs,
  first(t4.list_cost) as repair_list_cost,
  CASE WHEN t1.period_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t1.period_end_time - MIN(t2.period_end_time) as LONG) ELSE NULL END AS repair_time_seconds
FROM combined_repairs t1
  JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id)
  LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t3 USING (workspace_id, job_id)
  LEFT JOIN cost_per_unsuccesful_status_agg t4 USING (workspace_id, job_id, run_id)
WHERE
  t2.result_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t1.workspace_id, t1.job_id, t1.run_id, t1.period_end_time
ORDER BY repairs DESC

with stats_per_job_run as (
  SELECT
    t1.workspace_id,
    t1.usage_metadata.job_id,
    t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id as run_id,
    SUM(t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default) as list_cost,
    first(identity_metadata.run_as, true) as run_as,
    first(t1.custom_tags, true) as custom_tags,
    MAX(t1.usage_end_time) as last_seen,
    MIN(t1.usage_start_time) as first_seen
  FROM system.billing.usage t1 
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices on
      t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud and
      t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name and
      t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time and
      (t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time or list_prices.price_end_time is null)
  WHERE
      t1.sku_name LIKE '%JOBS%'
      AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
      AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id IS NOT NULL
      AND t1.usage_start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY 
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), 
stats_per_job AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    COUNT(run_id) AS runs,
    SUM(list_cost) AS total_list_cost,
    AVG(list_cost) AS avg_list_cost,
    MAX(list_cost) AS max_list_cost,
    percentile(list_cost, 0.9) AS p90
  FROM
    stats_per_job_run
  WHERE
    first_seen > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  GROUP BY ALL
  ORDER BY
    total_list_cost DESC
)
SELECT
  *,
  (max_list_cost - p90) AS list_cost_deviation_from_p90
FROM
  stats_per_job
ORDER BY
  list_cost_deviation_from_p90 DESC

cumulative_run_status_cost as (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, 
    job_id,
    run_id,
    run_as,
    result_state,
    usage_end_time,
    SUM(list_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost
  FROM job_run_timeline_with_cost
  ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time
),
cost_per_status as (
  SELECT
      workspace_id, 
      job_id,
      run_id,
      run_as,
      result_state,
      usage_end_time,
      cumulative_cost - COALESCE(LAG(cumulative_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time), 0) AS result_state_cost
  FROM cumulative_run_status_cost
  WHERE result_state IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_end_time),

  SELECT
    workspace_id, 
    job_id,
    FIRST(run_as, TRUE) as run_as,
    SUM(result_state_cost) as list_cost
  FROM cost_per_status
  WHERE
    result_state IN ('ERROR', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT')
  GROUP BY ALL
),
terminal_statues as (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    CASE WHEN result_state IN ('ERROR', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_failure,
    period_end_time as last_seen_date

  MAX(t1.last_seen_date) as last_seen_date
FROM terminal_statues t1 
  LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id)
  LEFT JOIN cost_per_status_agg t3 USING (workspace_id, job_id)

with usage_with_restrictions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        concat_ws(
          " ",
          CASE
            WHEN product_features.is_serverless THEN "SERVERLESS"
            ELSE ""
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN billing_origin_product = "JOBS" THEN "JOB"
            ELSE "PIPELINE"
          END
        ) as entity_type
      FROM
        system.billing.usage
      WHERE
        (
          billing_origin_product IN ("JOBS", "DLT", "LAKEFLOW_CONNECT")
          OR (
            billing_origin_product = "SQL"
            AND usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
        AND (
          usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date_22b610ad
          AND :param_end_date_22b610ad
        )
        AND IF(
          :param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>',
          true,
          workspace_id = :param_workspace_22b610ad
        )
        AND IF(
          :param_run_as_22b610ad = '<ALL USERS>',
          true,
          identity_metadata.run_as = :param_run_as_22b610ad
        )
        AND IF(
          :param_cluster_type_22b610ad = '<ALL CLUSTER TYPES>',
          true,
          IF(
            :param_run_as_22b610ad = 'Serverless',
            product_features.is_serverless = TRUE,
            product_features.is_serverless = FALSE
          )
        )
    )
  WHERE
    IF(
      :param_object_type_22b610ad = '<ALL>',
      true,
      IF(
        :param_object_type_22b610ad = 'Jobs',
        entity_type RLIKE "JOB",
        entity_type RLIKE "PIPELINE"
      )
    )
),
-- query
tag_key_selection as (
  select
    distinct(explode(map_keys(custom_tags))) as tag_key
  from
    usage_with_restrictions
)
select
  *
from
  tag_key_selection

with 
-- apply date filter
usage_filtered as (
  select
    u.*,
    workspace_name
  from
    system.billing.usage as u left JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
  where
    u.usage_date between :param_start_date_22b610ad
    and :param_end_date_22b610ad
    AND (
      billing_origin_product IN ("JOBS", "DLT", "LAKEFLOW_CONNECT")
      OR (
        billing_origin_product = "SQL"
        AND usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
    AND if(
      :param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>',
      true,
      workspace_name = :param_workspace_22b610ad
    )
    AND IF(
      :param_cluster_type_22b610ad = '<ALL CLUSTER TYPES>',
      true,
      IF(
        :param_cluster_type_22b610ad = 'Serverless',
        product_features.is_serverless = TRUE,
        product_features.is_serverless = FALSE
      )
    )
),
-- calc list priced usage in USD
prices as (
  select
    coalesce(price_end_time, date_add(current_date, 1)) as coalesced_price_end_time,
    *
  from
    system.billing.list_prices
  where
    currency_code = 'USD'
),
list_priced_usd as (
  select
    coalesce(u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.default, 0) as usage_usd,
    date_trunc('QUARTER', usage_date) as usage_quarter,
    date_trunc('MONTH', usage_date) as usage_month,
    date_trunc('WEEK', usage_date) as usage_week,
    u.*
  from
    usage_filtered as u
    left join prices as p on u.sku_name = p.sku_name
    and u.usage_unit = p.usage_unit
    and (
      u.usage_end_time between p.price_start_time
      and p.coalesced_price_end_time
    )
),
-- eval time_key param
list_priced_usd_with_time_key as (
  select
    identifier (
      case
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Quarter' then 'usage_quarter'
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Month' then 'usage_month'
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Week' then 'usage_week'
        else 'usage_date'
      end
    ) as time_key,
    *
  from
    list_priced_usd
),
-- eval group_key param
ws_count as (
  select
    count(distinct(workspace_name)) as workspace_count
  from
    list_priced_usd_with_time_key

),
top_workspace_usage as (
  select
    workspace_name as top_workspace,
    sum(usage_usd) as _top_ws_usage_usd
  from
    list_priced_usd_with_time_key
  group by
    top_workspace
  order by
    _top_ws_usage_usd desc
  limit
    10
), list_priced_usd_with_time_and_group_keys as (
  select
    if(
      workspace_count <= 50
      or top_workspace is not null,
      workspace_name,
      '<OTHERS>'
    ) as workspace_norm,
    identifier (
      case
        when :param_group_key_22b610ad = 'Workspace' then 'workspace_norm'
        when :param_group_key_22b610ad = 'SKU' then 'sku_name'
        when :param_group_key_22b610ad = 'Serverless' then 'product_features.is_serverless'
        else 'billing_origin_product'
      end
    ) as group_key,
    *
  from
    ws_count,
    list_priced_usd_with_time_key u
    left join top_workspace_usage on u.workspace_name = top_workspace_usage.top_workspace
) -- query
select
  time_key,
  group_key,
  usage_usd
from
  list_priced_usd_with_time_and_group_keys

with job_run_timeline_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.cloud,
    t1.workspace_id,
    t2.job_id,
    t2.run_id,
    t2.result_state,
    t2.termination_code,
    t1.usage_start_time,
    t1.usage_end_time,
    t1.sku_name,
    t1.usage_unit,
    t1.usage_quantity,
    date_trunc('QUARTER', usage_date) as usage_quarter,
    date_trunc('MONTH', usage_date) as usage_month,
    date_trunc('WEEK', usage_date) as usage_week,
    usage_date,
    t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default AS list_cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage t1
      INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2
        ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id
        AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time)
        AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
      INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices
        ON t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud
        AND t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name
        AND t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time
        AND (
          t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time
          or list_prices.price_end_time is NULL
        )
        AND IF(
          :param_cluster_type_22b610ad = '<ALL CLUSTER TYPES>',
          true,
          IF(
            :param_cluster_type_22b610ad = 'Serverless',
            product_features.is_serverless = TRUE,
            product_features.is_serverless = FALSE
          )
        )
        LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest USING (workspace_id)
  WHERE
    (usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date_22b610ad AND :param_end_date_22b610ad)
    AND IF(:param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, t1.workspace_id = :param_workspace_22b610ad)
),
job_run_timeline_with_time_key as (
  SELECT
    identifier(
      case
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Quarter' then 'usage_quarter'
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Month' then 'usage_month'
        when :param_time_key_22b610ad = 'Week' then 'usage_week'
        else 'usage_date'
      end
    ) as time_key,
    *
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_cost
),
cumulative_run_status_cost as (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    run_id,
    result_state,
    termination_code,
    time_key,
    SUM(list_cost) OVER (
        ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, time_key
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumulative_cost
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_time_key
  ORDER BY
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    run_id,
    time_key
)
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  job_id,
  run_id,
  result_state,
  termination_code,
  time_key,
  cumulative_cost
  - COALESCE(
    LAG(cumulative_cost) OVER (ORDER BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, time_key), 0
  ) AS result_state_cost
FROM
  cumulative_run_status_cost
WHERE
  result_state IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  workspace_id,
  job_id,
  run_id,
  time_key

with usage_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t1.identity_metadata.run_as,
    t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default as list_cost

      INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices
        on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud
        and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name
        and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time
        and (
          t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time
          or list_prices.price_end_time is null
        )
  WHERE
    (t1.usage_date BETWEEN :param_start_date_22b610ad AND :param_end_date_22b610ad)
),
job_run_timeline_with_cost as (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    t2.job_id,
    t2.run_id,
    t2.result_state
  FROM
    usage_with_cost t1
      INNER JOIN system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2
        ON t1.workspace_id = t2.workspace_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id = t2.job_id
        AND t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id = t2.run_id
        AND t1.usage_start_time >= date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_start_time)
        AND t1.usage_start_time < date_trunc("Hour", t2.period_end_time) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
),
status_boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    run_id,
    result_state,
    usage_start_time,
    usage_end_time,
    LAG(usage_end_time) OVER (
        PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id
        ORDER BY usage_start_time
      ) as prev_status_time
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_cost
  WHERE
    result_state IS NOT NULL
),
costs_by_status AS (
  SELECT
    t.workspace_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.run_id,
    sb.result_state,
    MIN(t.usage_start_time) as min_start_time,
    SUM(t.list_cost) as list_cost
  FROM
    job_run_timeline_with_cost t
      JOIN status_boundaries sb
        ON t.workspace_id = sb.workspace_id
        AND t.job_id = sb.job_id
        AND t.run_id = sb.run_id
        AND t.usage_start_time > COALESCE(sb.prev_status_time, CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 999 DAYS)
        AND t.usage_start_time <= sb.usage_end_time
  GROUP BY
    t.workspace_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.run_id,
    sb.result_state
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  costs_by_status t1 LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
WHERE
  if(:param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace_22b610ad)

queryLines:
with list_cost_per_job_cluster as (
  SELECT
    t1.workspace_id,
    t1.usage_metadata.job_id,
    t1.usage_metadata.cluster_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t1.usage_metadata.job_run_id) as runs,
    SUM(t1.usage_quantity * list_prices.pricing.default) as list_cost,
    first(identity_metadata.run_as, true) as run_as,
    first(t1.custom_tags, true) as custom_tags,
    MAX(t1.usage_end_time) as last_seen_date
  FROM
    system.billing.usage t1
      INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices list_prices
        on t1.cloud = list_prices.cloud
        and t1.sku_name = list_prices.sku_name
        and t1.usage_start_time >= list_prices.price_start_time
        and (
          t1.usage_end_time <= list_prices.price_end_time
          or list_prices.price_end_time is null
        )
      LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
  WHERE
    if(:param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace_22b610ad)
    and t1.product_features.is_serverless is FALSE
    AND t1.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t1.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
most_recent_jobs as (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) as rn
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY
    rn = 1
),
jobsrollingmonth as (
  SELECT
    t2.name,
    t1.job_id,
    t1.workspace_id,
    t1.cluster_id,
    t1.runs,
    t1.run_as,
    SUM(list_cost) as list_cost,
    t1.last_seen_date
  FROM
    list_cost_per_job_cluster t1 LEFT JOIN most_recent_jobs t2 USING (workspace_id, job_id)
  GROUP BY
    ALL
  ORDER BY
    list_cost DESC
),
jobswithutil AS (
  SELECT
    jobsrollingmonth.workspace_id,
    jobsrollingmonth.name,
    driver,
    AVG(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS `Avg CPU Utilization`,
    MAX(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS `Peak CPU Utilization`,
    AVG(cpu_wait_percent) AS `Avg CPU Disk Wait`,
    MAX(cpu_wait_percent) AS `Max CPU Disk Wait`,
    AVG(mem_used_percent) AS `Avg Memory Utilization`,
    MAX(mem_used_percent) AS `Max Memory Utilization`
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline
      JOIN jobsrollingmonth
        ON node_timeline.cluster_id = jobsrollingmonth.cluster_id
  WHERE
    start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY
    jobsrollingmonth.workspace_id,
    jobsrollingmonth.name,
    driver
),
parsed_jobs_utils AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    name,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Avg CPU Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Avg CPU Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Avg CPU Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Avg CPU Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Peak CPU Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Peak CPU Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Peak CPU Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Peak CPU Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Avg CPU Disk Wait`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Avg CPU Disk Wait`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Avg CPU Disk Wait`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Avg CPU Disk Wait`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Max CPU Disk Wait`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Max CPU Disk Wait`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Max CPU Disk Wait`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Max CPU Disk Wait`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Avg Memory Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Avg Memory Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Avg Memory Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Avg Memory Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = TRUE THEN `Max Memory Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Driver Max Memory Utilization`,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN driver = FALSE THEN `Max Memory Utilization`
      END
    ) AS `Workers Max Memory Utilization`
  FROM
    jobswithutil
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    name
),
finalutil as (
  select
    parsed_jobs_utils.*,
    sum(jobsrollingmonth.list_cost) as jobcostrolling30
  from
    parsed_jobs_utils
      join jobsrollingmonth
        on parsed_jobs_utils.workspace_id = jobsrollingmonth.workspace_id
        AND parsed_jobs_utils.name = jobsrollingmonth.name
  group by
    ALL
)
select
  *,
  ((jobcostrolling30 * (1 - (`Workers Avg CPU Utilization` / 100))) / 2.0) as maxsavings
from
  finalutil
WHERE
  `Workers Avg CPU Utilization` <= :param_cluster_utilization_22b610ad
order by
  maxsavings desc
limit 25

WITH aggregated_data AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN start_time >= current_date - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'last_30_days'
      WHEN
        start_time >= current_date - INTERVAL '60 days'
        AND start_time < current_date - INTERVAL '30 days'
      THEN
        'prev_30_60_days'
    END AS time_period,
    cluster_id,
    cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent AS cpu_utilization,
    mem_used_percent,
    (CAST(end_time - start_time AS LONG)) / 3600.0 AS machine_hours
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline t1
      LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest t2 USING (workspace_id)
  WHERE
    if(:param_workspace_22b610ad = '<ALL WORKSPACES>', true, t2.workspace_name = :param_workspace_22b610ad)
    AND start_time >= current_date - INTERVAL '60 days'
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    time_period,
    AVG(cpu_utilization) / 100.0 AS avg_cpu_utilization,
    AVG(mem_used_percent) / 100.0 AS avg_mem_utilization,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) AS num_clusters,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN cpu_utilization < 30 THEN cluster_id
      END
    )
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id), 0) AS pct_clusters_low_cpu,
    SUM(machine_hours) AS total_machine_hours,
    SUM(machine_hours)
    * (100.0 / NULLIF(AVG(cpu_utilization), 0) - 1) AS potential_savings_machine_hours
  FROM
    aggregated_data
  WHERE
    time_period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    time_period
)
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN avg_cpu_utilization
    END
  ) AS avg_cpu_util_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN avg_cpu_utilization
    END
  ) AS avg_cpu_util_prev_30_60,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN avg_mem_utilization
    END
  ) AS avg_mem_util_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN avg_mem_utilization
    END
  ) AS avg_mem_util_prev_30_60,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN num_clusters
    END
  ) AS num_clusters_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN num_clusters
    END
  ) AS num_clusters_prev_30_60,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN pct_clusters_low_cpu
    END
  ) AS pct_clusters_low_cpu_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN pct_clusters_low_cpu
    END
  ) AS pct_clusters_low_cpu_prev_30_60,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN total_machine_hours
    END
  ) AS total_machine_hours_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN total_machine_hours
    END
  ) AS total_machine_hours_prev_30_60,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'last_30_days' THEN potential_savings_machine_hours
    END
  ) AS potential_savings_machine_hours_last_30,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN time_period = 'prev_30_60_days' THEN potential_savings_machine_hours
    END
  ) AS potential_savings_machine_hours_prev_30_60
FROM
  metrics;
